<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A public affair became <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=controversial&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>controversial</strong></a> when a minor administrative problem revealed a wider issue of discrimination.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一个小行政问题揭露更广泛的歧视议题后，一件公共事务引发争议。</p></li>

### 词群 05.04｜教学怎样影响学习者 {#group-05-04}

**串联方式：** 从灌输、填鸭到强调与提升，再讨论启发、激励和纵容等不同影响。

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-025">
<summary><h4 id="word-05-025" class="vocabulary-word-title">instil<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-05-025" aria-label="定位 instil">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="05-025" data-mark-label="instil" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="instil：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="instil：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=instil&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 instil" title="在有道查询 instil">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">05-025</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.逐渐灌输 (=instill)</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Teachers emphasise regular practice to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=instil&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>instil</strong></a> confidence rather than encourage students to cram.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">教师强调经常练习，以培养信心，而非鼓励学生临考突击。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">To <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=instil&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>instil</strong></a> lasting habits, tutors emphasise planning so students do not cram at midnight.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">为培养持久习惯，导师强调计划，避免学生半夜突击。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Schools that emphasise exam results alone may <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=instil&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>instil</strong></a> anxiety and pressure pupils to cram.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">仅强调考试结果的学校可能使学生产生焦虑，并迫使他们突击学习。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">instil confidence</span> · 逐渐培养信心</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=revision&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">revision</a></span> · 复习</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=confidence&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">confidence</a></span> · 信心</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<summary><h4 id="word-05-026" class="vocabulary-word-title">cram<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-05-026" aria-label="定位 cram">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="05-026" data-mark-label="cram" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="cram：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="cram：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=cram&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 cram" title="在有道查询 cram">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">05-026</span></span></summary>

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Teachers emphasise regular practice to instil confidence rather than encourage students to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=cram&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>cram</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">教师强调经常练习，以培养信心，而非鼓励学生临考突击。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">To instil lasting habits, tutors emphasise planning so students do not <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=cram&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>cram</strong></a> at midnight.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">为培养持久习惯，导师强调计划，避免学生半夜突击。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Schools that emphasise exam results alone may instil anxiety and pressure pupils to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=cram&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>cram</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">仅强调考试结果的学校可能使学生产生焦虑，并迫使他们突击学习。</p></li>
</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=all-round&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>All-round</strong></a> education values intelligent questions and clever ideas alongside smart practical decisions.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">全面教育重视聪明的问题、巧妙想法及明智的实际决定。</p></li>

</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Calling one child a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=genius&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>genius</strong></a> and another an idiot can reinforce the idea of a fixed academic elite.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">称一个孩子为天才、另一个为傻瓜，会强化学业精英地位固定不变的观念。</p></li>

</ol>

<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A capable mentor recognised her aptitude, encouraged her wit and shared practical <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=wisdom&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>wisdom</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一位能干导师识别出她的天赋，鼓励她的机智，并分享实践智慧。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Aptitude and wit made him a capable debater, but experience brought <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=wisdom&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>wisdom</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">天赋和机智使他成为有能力的辩论者，经验则带来智慧。</p></li>

</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Aptitude and <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=wit&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>wit</strong></a> made him a capable debater, but experience brought wisdom.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">天赋和机智使他成为有能力的辩论者，经验则带来智慧。</p></li>

</ol>

### 词群 05.07｜谁来设计并实施教学 {#group-05-07}

**串联方式：** 从方法与方案进入校长、院长、教授、导师及助教等角色；candidate 可是申请者或考生。

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The headmaster, college principal and university dean discussed a shared <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=approach&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>approach</strong></a> to the mentoring scheme.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">中学校长、学院院长和大学院长讨论了导师辅导计划的共同方法。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A dean advised the principal and headmaster on an <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=approach&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>approach</strong></a> that would improve the scheme.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一位大学院长向学院院长和中学校长建议改进该计划的方法。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The scheme uses an <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=approach&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>approach</strong></a> endorsed by a headmaster, a principal and a dean.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这项计划采用了一位中学校长、一位学院院长及一位大学院长认可的方法。</p></li>
</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The professor asked faculty members to consider both the scholar's interpretation and the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=scientist&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>scientist</strong></a>'s evidence.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">教授要求教职人员同时考虑学者的解读和科学家的证据。</p></li>
</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Each diploma names the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=degree&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>degree</strong></a> awarded, such as Bachelor of Arts, Master of Arts or Doctor of Philosophy.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">每张文凭注明所授学位，如文学学士、文学硕士或哲学博士。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The college offers no Doctor of Philosophy <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=degree&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>degree</strong></a>, but issues a diploma for each Bachelor of Arts and Master of Arts graduate.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">该学院不授哲学博士学位，但为每位文学学士和文学硕士毕业生颁发文凭。</p></li>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Each diploma names the degree awarded, such as Bachelor of Arts, Master of Arts or <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=doctor&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>Doctor</strong></a> of Philosophy.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">每张文凭注明所授学位，如文学学士、文学硕士或哲学博士。</p></li>

</ol>

### 词群 05.11｜实验与化学变化 {#group-05-11}

**串联方式：** 实验产生数据，区分数量和质量，再观察发酵、沸腾、熔化、溶解、生锈及稀释，辨认酸和有害性。

<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Boil the water, dissolve the sugar and melt the fat, then cool the mixture before allowing it to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ferment&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>ferment</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">烧开水，溶解糖并融化脂肪，然后冷却混合物再让其发酵。</p></li>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The recipe asks us to melt butter, dissolve sugar and boil milk before mixing ingredients that will <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ferment&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>ferment</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">配方要求先融化黄油、溶解糖及煮沸牛奶，然后混合将要发酵的原料。</p></li>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-247">

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.(使)生锈；n.锈，铁锈</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Dilute the acid carefully before using it to remove <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=rust&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>rust</strong></a>, and avoid breathing noxious fumes.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">用酸除锈前须小心稀释，并避免吸入有害烟气。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The acid used on <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=rust&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>rust</strong></a> may release noxious vapour, even after technicians dilute it.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">即使技术人员将酸稀释，用其除锈时仍可能释放有害蒸气。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Do not dilute an unknown acid near <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=rust&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>rust</strong></a> or other metals, as noxious gases may form.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">不要在铁锈或其他金属附近稀释未知酸，因为可能生成有害气体。</p></li>
</ol>

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=gravity&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>Gravity</strong></a> turns the eccentric wheel, while friction slows it as its paddles displace water.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">重力使偏心轮转动，叶片排开水时，摩擦使它减速。</p></li>

</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The experiment measures how gravity and <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=friction&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>friction</strong></a> affect an eccentric wheel used to displace liquid.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">实验测量重力和摩擦如何影响一个用于排开液体的偏心轮。</p></li>

</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Her diary inspired a short story, a folk <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=tale&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>tale</strong></a> retelling and a collection mixing fiction with poetry.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她的日记启发了一篇短篇故事、一部民间故事改写，以及一本融合小说和诗歌的作品集。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The course compares a diary with a fictional story, a traditional <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=tale&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>tale</strong></a> and poetry to explore different forms of fiction.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">课程比较日记、虚构故事、传统传说和诗歌，以探讨不同的虚构写作形式。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The writer moved from diary entries to poetry, then transformed a family <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=tale&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>tale</strong></a> into a story of historical fiction.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">作家从日记转向诗歌，随后将家族传说改写为历史小说故事。</p></li>

### 词群 05.16｜选择专业：社会科学与思想 {#group-05-16}

**串联方式：** 从主修、辅修进入社会、政治、经济、心理、哲学和逻辑等学科。

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-148">

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">My major is sociology, my minor is politics, and history is another <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=subject&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>subject</strong></a> I enjoy.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我主修社会学，辅修政治学，历史是我喜欢的另一门学科。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Students may major in politics and take sociology as a minor <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=subject&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>subject</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">学生可以主修政治学，将社会学作为辅修科目。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Combining a sociology major with a politics minor helps me examine the same <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=subject&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>subject</strong></a> from different perspectives.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">主修社会学、辅修政治学有助于我从不同角度研究同一主题。</p></li>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Measure the volume of this ounce of metal to calculate its <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=density&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>density</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">测量这一盎司金属的体积，以计算密度。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=density&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>Density</strong></a> determines how much space one ounce of a substance occupies.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">密度决定一盎司物质占多少空间。</p></li>

### 词群 05.22｜一门课怎样安排 {#group-05-22}

**串联方式：** 把必修要求、学期、课表、截止日期、课程、研讨会、论坛和教学大纲放到选课流程。

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-254">
<summary><h4 id="word-05-254" class="vocabulary-word-title">compulsory<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-05-254" aria-label="定位 compulsory">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="05-254" data-mark-label="compulsory" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="compulsory：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="compulsory：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=compulsory&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 compulsory" title="在有道查询 compulsory">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">05-254</span></span></summary>

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-304">

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n. 摘要；adj. 抽象的；v. 提取；把…抽象出</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=abstract&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>abstract</strong></a> explains how researchers postulate a cause, detect patterns and deliberate before they diagnose a learning difficulty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">摘要解释研究人员如何假设原因、发现规律，并在诊断学习困难前审慎思考。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Before we diagnose the problem, we deliberate on the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=abstract&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>abstract</strong></a>, postulate alternatives and detect weaknesses in the evidence.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">诊断问题前，我们仔细考虑摘要、假设其他可能，并发现证据弱点。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Scientists postulate a mechanism in the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=abstract&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>abstract</strong></a>, detect its effects and deliberate on how best to diagnose the resulting condition.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">科学家在摘要中假设一种机制、检测其影响，并审慎考虑如何最好地诊断由此产生的状况。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">a research abstract</span> · 研究摘要</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hypothesis&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">hypothesis</a></span> · 假说</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=diagnosis&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">diagnosis</a></span> · 诊断</li></ul>

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The abstract explains how researchers postulate a cause, detect patterns and deliberate before they <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=diagnose&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>diagnose</strong></a> a learning difficulty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">摘要解释研究人员如何假设原因、发现规律，并在诊断学习困难前审慎思考。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Before we <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=diagnose&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>diagnose</strong></a> the problem, we deliberate on the abstract, postulate alternatives and detect weaknesses in the evidence.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">诊断问题前，我们仔细考虑摘要、假设其他可能，并发现证据弱点。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Scientists postulate a mechanism in the abstract, detect its effects and deliberate on how best to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=diagnose&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>diagnose</strong></a> the resulting condition.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">科学家在摘要中假设一种机制、检测其影响，并审慎考虑如何最好地诊断由此产生的状况。</p></li>
</ol>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-309">
<summary><h4 id="word-05-309" class="vocabulary-word-title">plagiarise<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-05-309" aria-label="定位 plagiarise">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="05-309" data-mark-label="plagiarise" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="plagiarise：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="plagiarise：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=plagiarise&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 plagiarise" title="在有道查询 plagiarise">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">05-309</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.抄袭</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Do not <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=plagiarise&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>plagiarise</strong></a>: if you copy and print a passage, acknowledge its source.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">不要抄袭：复制并打印段落时，应注明来源。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Students may copy a blank form and print it, but must not <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=plagiarise&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>plagiarise</strong></a> completed answers.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">学生可以复制并打印空白表格，但不得抄袭已完成的答案。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Before you print the essay, check that any copy of another writer's words is credited so you do not <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=plagiarise&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>plagiarise</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">打印文章前，检查复制的他人文字是否注明来源，以免抄袭。</p></li>
</ol>

<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=plagiarism&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">plagiarism</a></span> · 抄袭</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=citation&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">citation</a></span> · 引用</li></ul>

### 词群 05.27｜提出假设与表达判断 {#group-05-27}

**串联方式：** 先假设、推测和预测，再感知、识别并表达看法；imply 与 represent 用于含义与代表。

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Do not <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=assume&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>assume</strong></a> agreement or presume support simply because you suppose everyone understands.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">不要仅因你以为人人都理解，就假定大家同意或支持。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Suppose the sample is incomplete: we cannot <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=assume&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>assume</strong></a> accuracy or presume that it represents everyone.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">假设样本不完整：我们不能假定准确，也不能推定它代表所有人。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">We may suppose the trend will continue, but should not <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=assume&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>assume</strong></a> certainty or presume to know the outcome.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我们可以设想趋势继续，但不应假定确定性，或自认为知道结果。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">assume responsibility</span> · 承担责任</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=assumption&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">assumption</a></span> · 假设</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=presumption&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">presumption</a></span> · 推定</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Suppose the sample is incomplete: we cannot assume accuracy or <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=presume&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>presume</strong></a> that it represents everyone.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">假设样本不完整：我们不能假定准确，也不能推定它代表所有人。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">We may suppose the trend will continue, but should not assume certainty or <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=presume&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>presume</strong></a> to know the outcome.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我们可以设想趋势继续，但不应假定确定性，或自认为知道结果。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">presume innocence</span> · 假定无罪</p>

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=suppose&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>Suppose</strong></a> the sample is incomplete: we cannot assume accuracy or presume that it represents everyone.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">假设样本不完整：我们不能假定准确，也不能推定它代表所有人。</p></li>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-332">
<summary><h4 id="word-05-332" class="vocabulary-word-title">hypothesis<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-05-332" aria-label="定位 hypothesis">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="05-332" data-mark-label="hypothesis" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="hypothesis：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="hypothesis：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hypothesis&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 hypothesis" title="在有道查询 hypothesis">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">05-332</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n.假说，假设</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hypothesis&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hypothesis</strong></a> lets us predict outcomes rather than merely speculate about causes.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">假说使我们能预测结果，而非只是推测原因。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Researchers speculate about a mechanism, propose a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hypothesis&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hypothesis</strong></a> and predict what a test should reveal.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">研究者推测机制、提出假说，并预测测试应揭示什么。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">We cannot confidently predict the result from this <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hypothesis&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hypothesis</strong></a>, although we can speculate.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我们无法依据这一假说有把握地预测结果，尽管可以推测。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">test a hypothesis</span> · 检验假说</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=prediction&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">prediction</a></span> · 预测</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hypothetical&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">hypothetical</a></span> · 假设性的</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-333">
<summary><h4 id="word-05-333" class="vocabulary-word-title">speculate<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-05-333" aria-label="定位 speculate">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="05-333" data-mark-label="speculate" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="speculate：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="speculate：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=speculate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 speculate" title="在有道查询 speculate">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">05-333</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.推测</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A hypothesis lets us predict outcomes rather than merely <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=speculate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>speculate</strong></a> about causes.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">假说使我们能预测结果，而非只是推测原因。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Researchers <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=speculate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>speculate</strong></a> about a mechanism, propose a hypothesis and predict what a test should reveal.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">研究者推测机制、提出假说，并预测测试应揭示什么。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">We cannot confidently predict the result from this hypothesis, although we can <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=speculate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>speculate</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我们无法依据这一假说有把握地预测结果，尽管可以推测。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">speculate about causes</span> · 推测原因</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=prediction&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">prediction</a></span> · 预测</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hypothetical&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">hypothetical</a></span> · 假设性的</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-334">
<summary><h4 id="word-05-334" class="vocabulary-word-title">predict<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-05-334" aria-label="定位 predict">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="05-334" data-mark-label="predict" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="predict：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="predict：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=predict&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 predict" title="在有道查询 predict">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">05-334</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">V.预测</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A hypothesis lets us <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=predict&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>predict</strong></a> outcomes rather than merely speculate about causes.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">假说使我们能预测结果，而非只是推测原因。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Researchers speculate about a mechanism, propose a hypothesis and <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=predict&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>predict</strong></a> what a test should reveal.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">研究者推测机制、提出假说，并预测测试应揭示什么。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">We cannot confidently <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=predict&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>predict</strong></a> the result from this hypothesis, although we can speculate.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我们无法依据这一假说有把握地预测结果，尽管可以推测。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">predict an outcome</span> · 预测结果</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=prediction&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">prediction</a></span> · 预测</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hypothetical&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">hypothetical</a></span> · 假设性的</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-335">
<summary><h4 id="word-05-335" class="vocabulary-word-title">perceive<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-05-335" aria-label="定位 perceive">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="05-335" data-mark-label="perceive" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="perceive：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="perceive：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=perceive&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 perceive" title="在有道查询 perceive">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">05-335</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.感知，察觉，意识到</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A conscious observer may <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=perceive&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>perceive</strong></a> movement, discern a pattern and recognise a familiar object.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">有意识的观察者可能感知运动、辨出规律，并认出熟悉物体。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">We can <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=perceive&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>perceive</strong></a> a change without conscious effort, yet need attention to discern details and recognise its cause.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我们可能无须刻意就感知变化，却需集中注意力才能辨认细节并识别原因。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The experiment asks whether conscious participants <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=perceive&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>perceive</strong></a> the image, discern its outline and recognise the face.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">实验探究清醒参与者能否感知图像、辨出轮廓并认出面孔。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">perceive a difference</span> · 察觉差异</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=perception&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">perception</a></span> · 感知</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=recognition&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">recognition</a></span> · 识别</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-336">
<summary><h4 id="word-05-336" class="vocabulary-word-title">discern<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-05-336" aria-label="定位 discern">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="05-336" data-mark-label="discern" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="discern：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="discern：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=discern&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 discern" title="在有道查询 discern">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">05-336</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.觉察出；分辨出</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A conscious observer may perceive movement, <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=discern&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>discern</strong></a> a pattern and recognise a familiar object.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">有意识的观察者可能感知运动、辨出规律，并认出熟悉物体。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">We can perceive a change without conscious effort, yet need attention to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=discern&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>discern</strong></a> details and recognise its cause.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我们可能无须刻意就感知变化，却需集中注意力才能辨认细节并识别原因。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The experiment asks whether conscious participants perceive the image, <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=discern&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>discern</strong></a> its outline and recognise the face.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">实验探究清醒参与者能否感知图像、辨出轮廓并认出面孔。</p></li>
</ol>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-341">
<summary><h4 id="word-05-341" class="vocabulary-word-title">imply<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-05-341" aria-label="定位 imply">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="05-341" data-mark-label="imply" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="imply：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="imply：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=imply&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 imply" title="在有道查询 imply">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">05-341</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.暗指，意味着</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Researchers insist that the figures represent uncertainty and do not <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=imply&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>imply</strong></a> certainty while doubts persist.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">研究者坚称，这些数字代表不确定性；疑问仍存时，它们不意味着确定性。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Critics persist in asking what the symbols represent, while authors insist they do not <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=imply&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>imply</strong></a> causation.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">批评者持续追问符号代表什么，作者则坚持它们不暗示因果关系。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">We insist that models represent evidence honestly and never <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=imply&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>imply</strong></a> problems have vanished when they persist.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我们坚持模型如实呈现证据，问题仍存在时绝不暗示其已经消失。</p></li>
</ol>

</div>
</details>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Critics persist in asking what the symbols <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=represent&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>represent</strong></a>, while authors insist they do not imply causation.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">批评者持续追问符号代表什么，作者则坚持它们不暗示因果关系。</p></li>

<ol class="vocabulary-examples">

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">We <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=insist&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>insist</strong></a> that models represent evidence honestly and never imply problems have vanished when they persist.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我们坚持模型如实呈现证据，问题仍存在时绝不暗示其已经消失。</p></li>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-344">

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.坚持不懈；持续存在</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Researchers insist that the figures represent uncertainty and do not imply certainty while doubts <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=persist&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>persist</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">研究者坚称，这些数字代表不确定性；疑问仍存时，它们不意味着确定性。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Critics <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=persist&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>persist</strong></a> in asking what the symbols represent, while authors insist they do not imply causation.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">批评者持续追问符号代表什么，作者则坚持它们不暗示因果关系。</p></li>

</ol>

### 词群 05.29｜学习中的差异与衔接 {#group-05-29}

**串联方式：** fee 单独记费用；其余词用于讨论重叠、矛盾、分歧、多样性、细微差别和归纳。

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-356">
<summary><h4 id="word-05-356" class="vocabulary-word-title">fee<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-05-356" aria-label="定位 fee">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="05-356" data-mark-label="fee" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="fee：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="fee：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=fee&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 fee" title="在有道查询 fee">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">05-356</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n. 酬金；费用</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Although course contents overlap, tutors disagree about the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=fee&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>fee</strong></a>, differ on assessment and see a contradiction in policy.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">尽管课程内容重叠，导师对学费有分歧、评估方式不同，并认为政策存在矛盾。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The courses differ in <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=fee&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>fee</strong></a> but overlap in content; reviewers disagree on whether this creates a contradiction.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">课程学费不同但内容重叠，评审对这是否构成矛盾有分歧。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Students disagree over a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=fee&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>fee</strong></a> increase when courses overlap, although their views differ on the apparent contradiction.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">课程重叠时，学生对涨学费意见不一，尽管他们对表面矛盾的看法各不相同。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">a tuition fee</span> · 学费</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=disagreement&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">disagreement</a></span> · 分歧</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=inconsistency&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">inconsistency</a></span> · 不一致</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The results illustrate the effect, demonstrate its scale and manifest a pattern, but cannot <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=confirm&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>confirm</strong></a> causation or prove the theory.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">结果说明效应、展示规模并显现规律，但不能证实因果或证明理论。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">To prove the claim, <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=confirm&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>confirm</strong></a> the measurements, demonstrate the mechanism, illustrate each stage and explain how its effects manifest.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">要证明说法，须核实测量、展示机制、说明各阶段，并解释效应如何显现。</p></li>

</ol>

<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The results illustrate the effect, demonstrate its scale and manifest a pattern, but cannot confirm causation or <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=prove&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>prove</strong></a> the theory.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">结果说明效应、展示规模并显现规律，但不能证实因果或证明理论。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">To <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=prove&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>prove</strong></a> the claim, confirm the measurements, demonstrate the mechanism, illustrate each stage and explain how its effects manifest.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">要证明说法，须核实测量、展示机制、说明各阶段，并解释效应如何显现。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Experiments confirm the observation, illustrate the trend and demonstrate how symptoms manifest, but do not <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=prove&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>prove</strong></a> every proposed explanation.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">实验证实观察、说明趋势并展示症状如何显现，但未证明所有提出的解释。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">prove a claim</span> · 证明说法</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=confirmation&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">confirmation</a></span> · 证实</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">主题关联</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=proof&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">proof</a></span> · 证明</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Before we decide who is responsible, <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=determine&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>determine</strong></a> the facts and resolve contradictions.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">决定谁负责前，先查明事实并解决矛盾。</p></li>

</ol>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="05-376">
<summary><h4 id="word-05-376" class="vocabulary-word-title">research<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-05-376" aria-label="定位 research">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="05-376" data-mark-label="research" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="research：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="research：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=research&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 research" title="在有道查询 research">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">05-376</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n.调查；探索</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Our <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=research&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>research</strong></a> combines a questionnaire with visits to observe lessons, inquire about difficulties and query unclear responses.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我们的研究结合问卷与访校，以观察课堂、询问困难并追问不清楚的回应。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Use the questionnaire to guide <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=research&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>research</strong></a>, observe patterns, inquire further and raise a query when evidence conflicts.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">用问卷指导研究、观察规律、继续调查，并在证据冲突时提出疑问。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=research&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>research</strong></a> team will observe classes, inquire about each query and revise the questionnaire.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">研究团队将观察课堂、就每个疑问展开询问，并修改问卷。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">conduct research</span> · 开展研究</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=respondent&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">respondent</a></span> · 受访者</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=methodology&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">methodology</a></span> · 研究方法</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Use the questionnaire to guide research, <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=observe&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>observe</strong></a> patterns, inquire further and raise a query when evidence conflicts.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">用问卷指导研究、观察规律、继续调查，并在证据冲突时提出疑问。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The research team will <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=observe&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>observe</strong></a> classes, inquire about each query and revise the questionnaire.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">研究团队将观察课堂、就每个疑问展开询问，并修改问卷。</p></li>

<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n.疑问；询问；v.怀疑；询问</p>

<ol class="vocabulary-examples">

### 本章 Language Takeaway

优先尝试主动说出的三个表达：

- **acquire knowledge and skills**：获得知识与技能。
- **analyse the data**：分析数据。
- **support an argument with evidence**：用证据支持论点；argument 在第 20 章、evidence 在第 18 章出现。

### 串学示范｜自拟短文

University education should help students acquire knowledge and develop practical skills. In a seminar, they may compare theories, analyse data and question an assumption. When writing an essay, they need to cite sources and support their opinions with examples. Feedback then helps them revise their work.

**中文理解：** 大学教育应帮助学生获得知识并发展实际技能。在研讨课上，学生可以比较理论、分析数据和质疑假设。写文章时，他们需要引用来源，并用例子支持观点。反馈随后帮助他们修改作品。

### 闭卷回忆｜先尝试，再逐级提示

**任务：** 从入学到完成一篇论文，依次说明需要接触的人、材料、课程和研究步骤。

1. 关掉本章正文，在空白页列出你记得的词群；每群先写 3—5 个英文词或搭配。
2. 从中选 3 个词群，连成 3—5 句英文；用明确关系连接，专业分类和事实不确定时先核对。
3. 卡住时，先只看“本章主线”；还想不起，再看词群标题和中文简释，最后才看英文。
4. 用核对编号找出遗漏词；把“见到认得”与“想表达时能说出”分开记录。
5. 合上提示重新说一遍；下次换一个对象、地点或例子，检查能否迁移。
